name: Anzu
source:
The governess of the Kumonoito District. No one really knows much about her.

There are many rumors circling Anzu, half of which are about her peerless beauty.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/-the-tail-makes-the-fox]itch.io[/url]]
